Package io.webagent4j.locator.api

package io.webagent4j.locator.api
Immutable, backend-neutral locator definitions and the fluent query contracts every semantic search builds on - IFind and ILocator contain no engine logic and no backend-native type.

LocatorDefinition is the immutable record a fluent query ultimately assembles: role, accessible name, label, text, attribute, or an explicit css()/xpath() escape hatch, plus optional timeout and stability requirements. ILocatorScope is the typed contract behind within(...), so a scope is checked at compile time rather than by a runtime instanceof. IElementReference and ElementReference are re-resolvable handles: resolving one re-executes the definition against current state rather than returning a cached node.

The resolution engine that turns a LocatorDefinition into live elements lives in webagent4j-locator (ILocatorEngine, not in this module); this module exists so IElement#find() and IPage#find() can be declared without a dependency cycle. See docs/locators.md for the full resolution pipeline, ranking, and ambiguity contract.
